"''Yeah, well, get back to work.|The spice den guard and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} A [[Zabrak]] worked as a '''guard''' at [[The Den]], a [[spice]] production facility in [[Daiyu City]]. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] infiltrated The Den in search of a kidnapped [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], he was confronted by the Zabrak and a [[human]] guard who queried about his presence. Kenobi fought the pair, who put up a fierce fight, but managed to subdue them. He then forced the human worker to reveal where the girl was being held. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Also had the pleasure of showing my face as a Dathomirian Zabrak during episode 2. @obiwankenobi made quick work of this one. Definitely not as strong as Maul…|Tom O'Connell on [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]]|}} The Zabrak appeared in the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] episode "[[Part II]]," where he was played by [[Tom O'Connell]],{{Instagram|username=tommyohsee|url=p/CeZVWYGvLub|name=[[Tom O'Connell]]|date=2022-06-04|quote=Also had the pleasure of showing my face as a Dathomirian Zabrak during episode 2. @obiwankenobi made quick work of this one. Definitely not as strong as Maul…|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/uhvqa}} who also doubled as [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] for the series' fight scenes.{{Instagram|username=demeet2k|url=p/CeQUuOyOkLa|name=[[Dmitrious Bistrevsky]]|quote=The Cats out of the bag. I LIKE CATS 🐈‍⬛ Vader is played by three people, we all worked together to create the best Darth Vader in cinematic history. It's me, it's Hayden , It's Tom. We are a symbiosis. We all contributed our strengths to create the best representation of the character. (...) Hayden and I both act in the Darth Vader scenes, we bring the character and the emotions (and the pain, suffering, anger) I'm 6'7 so when you see a full body shot it looks better having an actor, vs a CGI creation. Tom specializes in the fighting. The fights are Tom. Full body with Helmet On is me, Hayden carries the heaviest burden of all, the pain and betrayal of his best friend and once mentor.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/MIwJG}} In the episode credits, the character is listed as "Spice Den Guard #1." ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სუნელის ბუნაგის უცნობი ზაბრაკი მცველი }} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Zabrak]]
